name: Warehouse operations — synthetic demo
description: Synthetic daily warehouse shifts. One row per shift; units and handling minutes describe operations rather than sales or orders.

units_shipped.label: Units shipped
units_shipped.description: Total units shipped during completed warehouse shifts.

completed_shifts.label: Completed shifts
completed_shifts.description: Number of completed shifts, at the configured one-row-per-shift grain.

handling_time_per_unit.label: Handling minutes per shipped unit
handling_time_per_unit.description: Total handling minutes divided by total shipped units for completed shifts. This is a weighted rate, not an average of per-shift averages.
